svg.title: Figure 4: Dependency-aware synthesis of current CGT analyses and their generalization boundaries
svg.desc: Five-panel synthesis of claim scope, nine study-conditioned candidate annotations, raw recurrence-versus-endpoint summaries, residual-transfer and grouped-fitness generalization boundaries, and a stop barrier before any causal-law claim.
